body:
Dear Southern Lighter,

  

 We hope you are having a fantastic Holiday Season so far.

  

 Below are reminders—and a few  very important updates . Please read everything carefully.

 If a question comes up, check our FAQ page  [HERE] .

 Still can’t find the answer? Reach out  [HERE] —we’re happy to help.

 GIVE SOUTHERN LIGHTS AS A CHRISTMAS GIFT  (Everyone)— 20% Discount!

 Know someone you’ve been telling about Southern Lights who’s never attended—on-site or virtual? Here’s how you can change that.

 Give a registration as a gift and receive  20% off each gifted registration . Click  [HERE] .

 Bring a spouse, best friend, adult child—or bless someone who otherwise couldn’t afford it or  needs a gentle nudge.

 WHEN & WHERE DO I REGISTER?  (In-person)

 Fri, January 23 · 9:00 AM–2:00 PM  — Strickland Auditorium

 After 2:00 PM, register at the bookstore in the Strickland lobby.

 Campus map:  [HERE]

 LODGING CHECK-IN AT EPWORTH  (In-person)

 Check in at the Administrative Office (see map   [HERE] ).

 Official check-in time is  4:00 PM , but you may check in upon arrival; your room will be assigned when ready.

 Room not ready? Leave luggage in the lobby and enjoy the island vibes.

 VIRTUAL VIEWING  (Virtual)

 Your email with the broadcast link + password will arrive by  noon on Thu, January 22 .

 Watch on a phone, tablet, or computer; Apple TV users can mirror to their TV.

 Pro tip: use Wi-Fi + power for a smooth stream.

 WHAT’S IN THE VIRTUAL STREAM?  (Virtual)

 All Main Sessions (1–6) + Speakers’ Panel

 Saturday Night Event

 Homily & Eucharist Service

 ON-DEMAND ACCESS  (Everyone)

 Everyone will receive a link the morning of  February 5  for on-demand viewing.

 Access to all sessions, the Speakers’ Panel, Saturday Night Event, and Sunday Service will be available until  April 30  for you to view and re-view at your leisure.

 CAN FRIENDS STILL REGISTER?  (Everyone)

 Yes—live or virtual:  [HERE]

 On-site housing is very limited, but nearby hotels and Airbnbs abound.

 Check our FAQ for suggestions.

 JOIN THE CONVERSATION  (Everyone)

 Are you a Southern Lights alum? Want to share your experience or meet new friends online? Follow us for speaker highlights, guiding questions, this years speakers quotes and more:

 Facebook:   Southern Lights Conference: An Adventure in Progressive Christianity

 Instagram:   @ southernlightsconference

 Bluesky:  @ southernlightsconf. bsky.social

 MEAL PACKAGES AT EPWORTH (In-person, Off-site)

 Staying off campus but want to dine with the group? Yes!

 Purchase here:  [HERE]

 UPDATED SCHEDULE  (Everyone)

 Find the latest schedule (updated as sessions finalize):  [HERE]

 Updates will be posted as information is available.

 YOGA RETURNS!  (In-person)

 Gentle morning yoga Saturday & Sunday with Belinda Lennon.

 We’ll have 20+ mats available—or bring your own.

 Learn more:  [HERE]

 IN CLOSING

  

 We wish you a blessed Advent and a very Merry Christmas—and leave you with this poem—

  

 Advent

 We wait,

not because we are certain,

but because the dark

has not prevailed.

  

 A small light is coming—

learning our names.

It does not hurry.

It does not break the door.

  

 Hope comes this way:

not crowned,

not shouting,

but close as breath

in the long night.

  

 So we keep watch.

Even now,

light is on its way.

 Anonymous

  

 —The Southern Lights Team

 Southern Lights Conference 2026

 Friday, January 23, 2026 at 9:00 AM – Sunday, January 25, 2026 at 12:00 PM (EST)

 Epworth By The Sea

100 Arthur J Moore Drive

St. Simons Island, GA 31522
